title: 第4章 一日两境第5章 烈焰狮王
lines: 只见这一本灵诀极为的破旧，上面布满了灰尘，很显然已经很久没有人动过了。
江玄将其取下，随后几个清晰古朴的大字便出现在了眼前。
“百拳镇体功，低级上品灵诀！”
“百拳出，天地震，邪道诛！练至大成，堪比高级上品灵诀！”
“好霸道的功法啊！”
江玄心花怒放，这功法虽说是极为霸道，但对于拥有九星神龙诀的他而言，正好互相配合，到时候想必力量会更强。
心中这般想着，江玄便心满意足的下了楼梯，直接来到了白袍老者那里登记。
这是百拳震体功？”
当看到江玄手上的一本灵诀时，白袍老者却是微微皱了下眉。
“小子，你确定要挑选这本灵诀吗？
虽然这本灵诀极为霸道，但若是本身灵气不足的话，可是会遭到反噬的！”
白袍老者语重心长的道，只因为修炼这本灵诀的风险极大，他着实不愿意看到一个日后有机会踏入真元境界天赋的小子因为修炼这本灵诀而前途尽毁。
“嗯！我确定！”
不过，在江玄的坚持下，白袍老者也只能摇了摇头，帮着江玄登记了一下取走的书籍，便将两本灵诀递给了江玄。
看着渐渐远去的背影，老者有些感叹：“这小子，年纪轻轻倒是有几分魄力，希望他能够量力而行，不要被那百拳震体功练废了才好啊！”
离开了藏书阁，江玄就打算前往山林间修炼。
“江玄？”
不过，一道声音让他的脚步停了下来。
他回头望去，就见一男一女朝他走来。
江玄目光微寒，因为这两人正是曾经背叛过他的江雪以及江家的天才江天逸。
“江玄，我听说你打败了江漠，而且最近似乎一直在努力修行。”
这时，江雪忽然开口，语气中带着些许不屑。
“你想说什么？”
江玄神色冰冷。
江雪见到江玄那冰冷的面色，摇了摇头，继续说道：“江玄，如果你是想要用这样一种方式来引起我的注意的话，那我劝你，还是省了吧！”
“现在的我们早已不在同一个阶层，这样的你就像小丑一样，只会让我更加的厌恶。”
“如今我已经是天逸哥的女人了，我劝你还是别再幻想那些没有的，癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，到头来只会伤了你自己。”
听到这话，江玄笑了，他没想到人竟然能无耻到这种地步。
一声怒喝，吓得江雪的面色苍白。
她连忙退后了几步。
“天逸哥！这个废物竟然欺负我！”
江雪楚楚可怜的道。
“小子，我现在给你两个选择，一、自废灵脉，给雪儿磕头认错。
二、月试中，我会亲自出手废了你。”
江天逸直接来口，霸道，冰冷，并没有任何商量的语气。
content_en:
I saw that this spiritual secret was extremely old and covered with dust. It was obvious that no one had touched it for a long time.
Jiang Xuan took it off, and then several clear and simple characters appeared in front of him.
"One hundred fists to suppress the body, low-level and high-level spiritual skills!"
"With hundreds of punches, the sky will quake, and evil will be punished! When you practice it to great perfection, it is comparable to the high-grade spiritual arts!"
"What a domineering technique!"
Jiang Xuan was elated. Although this technique was extremely overbearing, for him who possesses the Nine-Star Divine Dragon Art, it just works well with each other, and the power will surely be stronger by then.
With this thought in his mind, Jiang Xuan went down the stairs with satisfaction and went directly to the old man in white robe to register.
"Eh?
Is this the Hundred Fists Body Shaking Kung Fu? "
When he saw a book of spiritual secrets in Jiang Xuan's hand, the old man in white robe frowned slightly.
"Boy, are you sure you want to choose this spiritual secret?
Although this spiritual art is extremely domineering, if the spiritual energy itself is insufficient, it will suffer backlash! "
The old man in white robe said earnestly, just because the risk of practicing this spiritual secret is extremely high, he really does not want to see a talented kid who has the opportunity to enter the realm of true essence in the future have his future ruined because of practicing this spiritual secret.
"Yeah! I'm sure!"
However, under Jiang Xuan's insistence, the old man in white robe could only shake his head, help Jiang Xuan register the books he had taken, and then handed the two spiritual secrets to Jiang Xuan.
Looking at the retreating figure, the old man sighed: "This boy has some courage at a young age. I hope he can act according to his ability and not be ruined by those hundreds of punches that shake the body!"
After leaving the library, Jiang Xuan planned to go to the mountains and forests to practice.
"Jiang Xuan?"
However, a voice stopped him in his tracks.
He looked back and saw a man and a woman walking towards him.
Jiang Xuan's eyes were slightly cold, because these two people were Jiang Xue, who had betrayed him, and Jiang Tianyi, the genius of the Jiang family.
"Jiang Xuan, I heard that you defeated Jiang Mo, and you seem to have been practicing hard recently."
At this time, Jiang Xue suddenly spoke, with a bit of disdain in his tone.
"What do you want to say?"
Jiang Xuan looked cold.
Seeing Jiang Xuan's cold expression, Jiang Xue shook her head and continued: "Jiang Xuan, if you want to use this method to attract my attention, then I advise you to save it!"
"We are no longer in the same class now. You are like a clown, which will only make me more disgusted."
"Now that I am Brother Tianyi's woman, I advise you to stop imagining things that don't exist. If a toad wants to eat swan meat, it will only hurt yourself in the end."
Hearing this, Jiang Xuan laughed. He didn't expect people to be so shameless.
"Get out!"
An angry shout made Jiang Xue turn pale in fright.
She quickly took a few steps back.
"Brother Tianyi! This loser actually bullied me!"
Jiang Xuechu said pitifully.
"Boy, I'll give you two choices now. One, destroy your spiritual veins and kowtow to Xue'er to admit your mistake.
2. During the monthly test, I will personally destroy you. "
Jiang Tianyi spoke directly, domineeringly and coldly, without any discussion tone.
